angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 827,883 km at 105.14 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.5112 +/- 0.0120 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 105.14 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.19 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Tofflemire et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 110082 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract): 827,883 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.21 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Tofflemire et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 110082 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6200 +/- 100 K from Tofflemire et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 110082 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Tofflemire et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 110082 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-110082.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.370, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110082 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Tofflemire et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110082 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Tofflemire et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110082 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.28103, from Tofflemire et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110082 (pscomppars): age 0.25 Gyr, from Tofflemire et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110082 (pscomppars): rotation period 2.34 d, from Tofflemire et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110082 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 25.3 km/s, from Tofflemire et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..171T/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.19 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.983. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
